name: RTK
description: Filters and compresses shell command output such as git, test runs and builds before a coding agent reads it, via hooks for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.

skills.name: Git Output Compaction
skills.description: Rewrites git status, diff and log output into compact summaries grouped by state, keeping hash, author and subject only.

skills.name: Test Failure Filtering
skills.description: Filters cargo test, npm test, pytest and go test output down to failures, collapsing passing tests into a single count.

skills.name: Agent Hook Setup
skills.description: Installs a hook with rtk init that rewrites an agent's shell commands to rtk equivalents in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more.

skills.name: Output Analytics
skills.description: Reports how much command output was filtered with rtk gain, as summaries, daily breakdowns, ASCII graphs or JSON exports.

skills.name: API Traffic Proxy
skills.description: Runs the optional rtk-proxy daemon, which compresses an agent's provider-API payloads before forwarding them to the model provider.
